title: Ticket triage
blurb: Which team should handle this support ticket?
lesson: Jev answers with a probability for every category, so you can see how sure it was, even when it picks the wrong team.

title: Prompt-injection check
blurb: Should a shop's chatbot pass, review or block this message?
lesson: A guardrail runs on every message, so speed and cost per call matter as much as accuracy.

title: Review rating
blurb: How positive is this product review, on a scale of 5 levels?
lesson: A Score question gives Jev a scale to place the text on, and its probabilities show how it spread its bet across the levels.

title: Product match
blurb: Do two shop listings describe the same product?
lesson: Matching products is a yes or no per pair, which suits Jev when there are thousands of pairs to judge.

title: Citation check
blurb: Does the source text support the claim?
lesson: Checking a claim against a short source is a judgment on text you provide, which is the kind of question Jev answers well.

title: Intent routing
blurb: Which smart home device should handle this voice command?
lesson: Routing a request to one of a few handlers is a Choice, and an indirect phrasing is the place where models differ.

title: Date comparison
blurb: Which of two dates written in different styles comes first?
lesson: Dates in different styles are a known weak spot for System One models: the safe pattern is to extract the parts and let Code compare them.

title: Phishing signals
blurb: Which of 10 phishing signals does this email show?
lesson: Jev answers all 10 yes or no questions in one request, while the LLM writes all 10 answers out, so the cost of extra questions differs.
